dossier.scp_unleashed.015.title: Pipe Nightmare
dossier.scp_unleashed.015.caption: SCP-015 at intake: a single section, photographed beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-015 cannot be moved once it has taken hold. Any structure it occupies is declared a restricted site. No personnel are to sleep, work or store equipment inside one.

Cutting crews are to remove new growth along the edge of each site at the start of every shift. Cut sections are inert and are sent for scrap. **No length of SCP-015 is ever to be joined to working plumbing, a fluid line or a vent.**
A section recovered intact is to be kept crated and off the ground. It is never to be set down.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-015 is a network of iron pipe of ordinary industrial appearance, of a heavier gauge than any in standard use. A single section cannot be told apart from scrap pipe. It carries nothing.

Once a section is set in place, it begins to grow after a short delay. New lengths extend from it into the open space nearby, in straight runs joined by elbows and tees, as if laid by an unseen fitter. Each new length is joined only to the length it grew from. Runs that grow side by side never join one another.

Growth continues until every open space the network can reach is full. It then forces its way through the walls and floors around it, which fall away as rubble, and grows on into the gap. Sections cut away are slowly replaced.
Personnel inside a site report constant creaking, the groan of loaded metal and the sound of dripping water. No source of the water has been found.

page.title: Addendum 015-1: Test Log
text: Test 015-02: a section was set on the floor of a sealed storeroom. Growth began within seconds, and the room was full within the hour.
Test 015-05: a brick partition was raised across the growth. SCP-015 filled its side of the room, then broke the partition down.
Test 015-08: one section was cut from the middle of a run. The gap had grown back by the next morning.
Test 015-11: a section was laid against a working water main. It did not join the main, and no water entered it. %rTest abandoned.%r

page.title: Addendum 015-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-015 has no recovery record. A single section was handed to a reader of this file by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The individual would not say where it had been cut from. %rIt was still warm.%r See field notes.

block.scp_unleashed.scp015_pipe.breaks: When it runs out of room, it breaks through the blocks in its way
block.scp_unleashed.scp015_pipe.mined: Each section mined yields an iron ingot; gaps slowly grow back
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp015_pipe.1: SCP-015 looks like a single length of heavy iron pipe. Placed down it behaves like any other pipe, then after a few seconds it begins to grow.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp015_pipe.2: It runs new pipe into the open space around it, in straight runs with elbows and tees, until the space is full. When it has no room left, it breaks through the blocks around it, which drop as if mined, and keeps growing.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp015_pipe.3: Each section only joins the section it grew from and the sections it grew. It never connects to real pipes or vents and carries nothing. Mined with a pickaxe, each section yields an iron ingot, but gaps left behind are slowly filled again.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp015_pipe.4: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-015 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A few minutes later a stranger in Foundation dress finds you and hands it over.

gamerule.scp015SegmentLimit.description: SCP-015 stops growing in a dimension once this many sections exist there. 0 stops all growth.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp015.0: The courier handed over one length of pipe, like scrap.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp015.1: Wait somewhere open. Do not set it down indoors.
